before.name: Dana Briggs
before.description: Dana Briggs was a 70-year-old Air Force veteran arrested during a September 27, 2025 protest outside the Broadview ICE facility in Illinois. Federal prosecutors initially alleged assault and later reduced the accusation to a misdemeanor. Video showed an agent knocking Briggs down, and prosecutors ultimately dismissed the case. He was released September 29.
